For Diane / Astra: our standard requirements are:
- Completed W-9 (received)
- ACH authorization or bank letter (we can accept the bank details PDF but prefer a signed ACH form)
- Remit-to email to populate PO/AR (see format below)

Standard remit expectations: PO number in subject line, invoice PDF attached, net-30 unless otherwise agreed. Remit-to email for Redwood invoices is invoices@redwood.ai (we also accept electronic remittance to ap@redwood.ai if you use EFT notifications).

Marissa, please initiate the micro-deposit verification to the account provided and confirm amount to Diane so they can verify receipt. Diane — if you prefer, we can DocuSign an ACH authorization and I can send that link.
